Lighthouse Harbor Cruise - Private Cruise
services.desc: Come aboard, unwind, and explore Plymouth Harbor! 1 Hour 15 Minutes About Come aboard, unwind, and appreciate one of the town's most exquisite natural treasures, Plymouth Harbor. During the journey, the Captain will provide insights into the harbor's development, spanning from the days of our early settlers to the present. On the cruise, you will have the opportunity to admire: Plymouth Long Beach Coastline landmarks both nearby and in the distance The Duxbury Pier Lighthouse, affectionately known as the "Bug Light" by locals Clark's Island Saquish Beach Various species of shoreline For all ages! • 1 Hour 15 Minutes • Price includes up to 25 people • Option to add additional people
